I am starting university this September and was thinking about where I would like to see improvements and changes in my self by the next 4/5 years when I hopefully graduate : )

So Voat... how did you guys change? Did you find a new hobby that you never knew you would like... meet your true love... realize your a prodigy or simply stay the same?
How did you change after university or collage
I got to sleep and enjoy evenings/weekends.

I definitely became more responsible for myself. I had a regular sleeping schedule, paid for all my own stuff and bills (less reliance on the parents), kept the apartment clean (even helped cleaned parents house on visits), and learned about basic nutrition and cooking skills (lost the freshmen 15 and 20 more by my 3rd year).

Now I don't want to say I never went out and partied. I just normally made sure it was end of week or when I didn't have a bunch of homework due. Also a tip, do laundry when reading textbooks/doing homework as having to get up and change a load/fold the laundry is a perfect mental break to keep you from getting fraustrated.

I might also suggest joining a club related to your major that is affiliated with a proffesional organization. This is a great way to make connections for jobs and internships while at the same time making new friends.

I also did find my "true love" my last 6 months in the university. Currently I have a summer job 3hrs away but we still see each other almost every weekend and are looking for a house.

Edit: spelling

I got involved with different activities around campus and found out what I wanted to do with the rest of my life.

College is a great time to take advantage of clubs, internships, activities to find out what you really like (along with many other like-minded individuals). Try to dive into things you have interest in, because after college, you don't really get too many chances to do so.

I really got into academics. High School was a popularity contest and GPA was about 15th on the list for most people. Well that flipped when I got to University, well at least for the crowd I was running with at the time.

I finally discovered the things that really mattered and really started caring a lot less about the stupid things that everyone gets themselves worked up over. I grew up and didn't care about the things I couldn't control.
